alt: A two-page form from the Los Angeles County Department of Public Social Services for filing complaints of discriminatory treatment based on protected characteristics, including instructions and contact information.
summary:
This two-page document is a "Complaint of Discriminatory Treatment Form" issued by the Los Angeles County Department of Public Social Services (DPSS). It is designed for individuals to report alleged discrimination based on various protected characteristics, such as national origin, race, sex, age, disability, religion, and others, as defined by California Department of Social Services (CDSS) Division 21. The first page provides instructions on how to complete and submit the form, including options for anonymous submission, and lists contact information for the DPSS Civil Rights Section. The second page is the actual complaint form, requiring details like the basis of discrimination, date of occurrence, names of alleged discriminators, a description of the incident, and requested corrective action. It also includes consent sections regarding the release of personal information for investigation.

The form serves as a formal mechanism for individuals to exercise their right to complain about discriminatory treatment within the scope of DPSS services, aligning with CDSS Division 21 regulations. It explicitly states that using this specific form is not mandatory for filing a complaint, allowing for verbal, email, or other written submissions. A crucial legal aspect highlighted is the prohibition of retaliation against individuals who engage in protected activities, such as filing a complaint or participating in an investigation. The form's consent section underscores the importance of data privacy and the potential impact on an investigation if consent for information release is denied, balancing individual rights with investigative needs.

The document is largely consistent, providing clear instructions and a structured form. One minor observation is that the first page states "Complete the attached PA 607 form, Complaint of Discriminatory Treatment," implying the PA 607 is the form itself, which is then presented on the second page. The form's header on page 2 is "COMPLAINT OF DISCRIMINATORY TREATMENT" without "FORM" at the end, unlike page 1. The list of protected characteristics on page 1 is presented as bullet points, while on page 2, it's a checklist with checkboxes, which is appropriate for a form. The contact information for the Civil Rights Section is consistently provided on both pages. The form clearly distinguishes between a discrimination complaint and a retaliation complaint, emphasizing that retaliation is a separate, prohibited activity.

County of Los Angeles
Department of Public Social Services
COMPLAINT OF DISCRIMINATORY TREATMENT FORM
This form is to be used to file a DPSS complaint of discriminatory treatment for violations against any
of the protected classes covered under California Department of Social Services Division 21. According
to the Los Angeles County DPSS Civil Rights Handbook, this form is not required to formally submit a
discrimination complaint.
You may file a complaint if you feel that you have been discriminated against due to your:
• National Origin (Includes Language)
• Color
• Race
• Ancestry
• Ethnic Group Identification
• Age
• Sex
• Gender Expression
• Gender Identity
• Sexual Orientation
• Marital Status
• Domestic Partnership
• Medical Condition
• Genetic Information
• Religion
• Political Affiliation
• Disability (Physical or Mental)
• Citizenship
• Immigration Status
• Any other applicable basis
Instructions:
1. Complete the attached PA 607 form, Complaint of Discriminatory Treatment. Be sure to include
your name, telephone number, mailing address, case number, and a description of the alleged
discrimination (attach additional pages, if necessary). To submit your complaint anonymously,
you may leave the name section blank and write “Anonymous” in the signature section.
2. Provide the corrective action being requested to resolve the alleged discrimination.
3. Sign the form.
4. Submit the complaint form in-person at any DPSS office, by phone, fax, email, or by U.S. mail
to:
Department of Public Social Services
Civil Rights Section
12860 Crossroads Parkway South
City of Industry, CA 91746
Telephone: (562) 908-8501
Fax: (562) 692-2240
Email: DPSSCivilRights@dpss.lacounty.gov
Please Note:
• DPSS Civil Rights Section will assign an investigator who will acknowledge receipt of your
complaint in writing.
• Submitting a PA 607 is not a requirement to submit a report of discrimination; you may file a
written complaint by email, a verbal complaint by telephone, or by informing any DPSS
employee to initiate a complaint of discrimination.
• Retaliation is included as a protected activity under CDSS Division 21 and is prohibited. A
retaliation complaint is described as any form of intimidation, threatening, coercing, or
discriminating against any individual engaging in a protected activity, such as filing a
complaint, testifying, or participating in any manner in any investigation, proceeding, or
hearing. This is not the same as a discrimination complaint, however, it is prohibited under
CDSS Division 21.
